data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: windy
sections.question: windy
sections.summary: with a lot of wind blowing

senses.definition: with a lot of wind blowing; used to describe weather when there is a strong wind
examples: It was so windy that her umbrella blew inside out on the walk to school.
The windy weather made it difficult to cycle along the seafront.

answers.answer: It was so windy that her umbrella blew inside out on the walk to school.
He ordered a windy at the café and drank it slowly.
She put the windy in her bag before leaving the house.
They cooked the windy in a large pot for dinner.

sections.title: winter
sections.question: winter
sections.summary: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring

senses.definition: the coldest season of the year, coming after autumn and before spring, when the weather is cold and the days are short
examples: She wears a heavy coat and scarf in winter to stay warm.
In winter the temperature often drops below zero and sometimes it snows.

answers.answer: She wears a heavy coat and scarf in winter to stay warm.
She goes to the beach to swim in the sea every day in winter because it is so hot.
He wears shorts and a t-shirt in winter because the sun is very strong.
They spend every winter at the outdoor pool because the water is so warm.
